num_requests: <int> Total number of transportation requests to be fulfilled.
num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the network, including origin depot, pickup nodes, delivery nodes, and destination depot.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum load that each vehicle can carry at any point along its route.
planning_horizon: <int> Latest time by which all vehicles must return to the depot.
fixed_cost_per_vehicle: <int> Fixed cost incurred each time a vehicle is dispatched from the depot.

objective.primary: <str> The primary optimization goal for the fleet.
objective.secondary: <str> The secondary optimization goal, applied among solutions tied on the primary goal.

depot.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest departure and latest return times for vehicles at the depot.

requests.request_id: <int> Unique identifier for this transportation request.
requests.pickup_node: <int> Node index where the load for this request is picked up.
requests.delivery_node: <int> Node index where the load for this request is delivered.
requests.load: <int> Quantity of goods to be transported for this request.
requests.pickup_coord: <list[float], length 2> X and Y coordinates of the pickup location.
requests.delivery_coord: <list[float], length 2> X and Y coordinates of the delivery location.
requests.pickup_time_window: <list[float], length 2> Earliest and latest times at which service may begin at the pickup location.
requests.delivery_time_window: <list[float], length 2> Earliest and latest times at which service may begin at the delivery location.
requests.travel_time_pickup_to_delivery: <float> Travel time (Euclidean distance) from the pickup location to the delivery location for this request.

nodes.id: <int> Unique index of this node in the network.
nodes.demand: <int> Change in vehicle load when visiting this node (positive for pickups, negative for deliveries, zero for depots).
nodes.service_time: <int> Time spent servicing at this node before departing.
nodes.time_window: <list[float], length 2> Earliest and latest times at which service may begin at this node.
nodes.pair: <int> Node index of the corresponding paired pickup or delivery node (present only for pickup and delivery nodes).
